extractor_notes.blockers: PharmaCyte's Board has curtailed spending on its Cell-in-a-Box clinical programs (pancreatic cancer, diabetes, malignant ascites) due to an FDA clinical hold on its IND. Recent filings focus on external strategic investments (Femasys, MyMD/TNF Pharmaceuticals, LightSolver license via TNF) and a $7M Series C preferred stock raise. No active company-sponsored clinical catalysts disclosed.
